translations.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, will save it.
translations.bsb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
translations.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
